links.comparator_used: Few-shot prompting without retrieval (few-shot vs RAG-enhanced few-shot)
links.outcome: Entity-level extraction performance (precision, recall, accuracy, macro-F1) for oncological attributes from German pathology reports
links.effect: RAG further enhanced performance beyond few-shot, particularly for models with fewer than 24B parameters; with RAG, Mistral Small 24B achieved nearly equivalent performance to Llama 3.3 70B (F1 > 0.90) on most entity types. No numeric differences given in the abstract.
links.quote: Prompting strategy significantly impacted performance: few-shot prompting improved baseline accuracy, and RAG further enhanced performance, particularly for models with fewer than 24B parameters.

links.effect: Few-shot prompting improved baseline accuracy relative to zero-shot; no numeric values given in the abstract.
